notes.text: You can now use runtime APIs to activate or deactivate filter fields and update their labels from a controller extension
You can now use FieldControl to dynamically mark a child field as mandatory
We now hide the value help when no relevant qualifier applies for the context
You can now render images and full HTML in the display mode of fields by using the displayType property with the RichTextEditor building block
You can now navigate to a line item from a grid table cell by pressing Alt+Enter
We now ensure that the table works correctly when a variant is applied on a list report page with multiple tabs
